_about: Hand-sourced facts for the UPS Center trackers that no feed carries. Each caption cites a public team or wire page and its date. Injury return dates are never invented: a page that gives none is captioned as giving none. Re-check every caption each week (status changes). Public repo: no private chat, no offer comments.

terms.label: Cross set out the terms in the chat

unchanged.label: Cross confirmed they were riding it out with no changes

events.text: Hurt his right hamstring late in the Week 2 loss to Minnesota; coach Ben Johnson called him week to week.
Placed on injured reserve with a blood clot in his calf; the team gave no return date.
Left the Week 4 game against Tennessee at halftime with an ankle injury.
Returned for Week 8 at Buffalo and hurt his right thumb on the first snap; he scored zero.
Placed on injured reserve; the team said he would miss at least four games and no return date was given.

addison.text: Minnesota placed Jordan Addison on injured reserve with a thumb injury and said he will have minor surgery. The team expects him back in about four weeks from November 16. That is an estimate, not a date.
